description.ar: حوّل نص ماركداون إلى كود HTML جاهز للاستخدام.
description.en: Convert Markdown text to ready-to-use HTML code.

inspectedCodePaths: src/components/tools/MarkdownToHtml.tsx — local blob:/base64 raster data: images only; remote, unsafe, and malformed images become localized non-loading placeholders; no storage calls
evidence.networkEgressBasis: image preview rejects http(s), javascript:, and other non-local image URLs before rendering; only blob: and base64 raster data: URLs are allowed. Explicit links remain inert until user activation; no fetch/axios/XMLHttpRequest/WebSocket/sendBeacon/EventSource calls
